exceptions.what: Beautyrest.com orders (any item): one return per household per year (wording on the 100-night-trial page)
exceptions.quote: Our return policy only allows for one return per household per year, so we can only return and refund one item purchased within the same year.

exceptions.what: Mattresses: only one mattress can be returned or exchanged per household per 12 months

exceptions.what: Beautyrest.com mattresses (legal text): must be returned directly with Beautyrest no later than day 100 after delivery; mattress must be in the United States

exceptions.quote: The 100-Night In-Home Trial may not apply, or may apply differently, to purchases of Beautyrest Products via other authorized Beautyrest distribution channels, or from any other (unauthorized) sources.

general.term: Period depends on the code on the white law label; see depends_on. Coverage runs from the date of delivery.
general.starts_from_quote: The warranty coverage runs from the date of delivery.
general.covers: Manufacturing defects in the mattress or foundation (materials or workmanship), including the removable fabric cover on select models. Help center: excessive compressions, sagging, foam splitting or cracking, cover defects such as unraveling stitching.
general.covers_quote: The limited warranty covers manufacturing defects in your Beautyrest® or Simmons® mattress or foundation including faults in materials or manufacturing defects in the removable fabric cover available on select models.
general.covers_quote_2: For purchases made on Beautyrest.com, our 10-year limited warranty covers manufacturing defects such as excessive compressions, sagging, flaws in the foam causing it to split or crack, and cover defects, such as unraveling stitching.
general.excludes: Comfort preference, normal softening or foam recovery changes, normal body impressions per code, cover and handles, corner guards, bent border wires, burns/cuts/tears, vermin, stains or soil, inadequate foundation, adjustable foundations (separate warranty), as-is/distressed/floor models, claims outside the listed territory, transportation/inspection/removal costs (except California).
excludes_quotes: Normal changes in softness or recovery time of high density foams, including memory foam, due to normal use, temperature, or humidity.
Normal body impression(s) as indicated by your warranty code (see chart).
Mattresses used with an inadequate foundation and/or support system.
Adjustable foundations (see owner’s manual for details on warranty coverage).
Claims made outside the 50 United States, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico or U.S. Virgin Islands.
Transportation, inspection, or removal costs of product, except in California.
general.limits: Replacement does not extend the warranty; exclusive remedy is replacement in the US, Puerto Rico or US Virgin Islands; implied warranties limited to the term; no incidental or consequential damages.
limits_quotes: Replacement of the mattress or foundation does not extend its limited warranty or begin a new limited warranty period.
the exclusive remedy under this warranty will be replacement of the defective product in the U.S., Puerto Rico or U.S. Virgin Islands.
Simmons shall not be liable for incidental or consequential damages that result from the use of your Beautyrest® or Simmons® product.
general.quote: Your warranty period is based on the code printed on your white law label as indicated on the Warranty Code Chart below.

unclear: Return limit wording differs: returns page 'One return or exchange per household per 12 months'; 100-night-trial page and warranties-after-march 'one return per household per year'; help articles say it counts 'one mattress'. Whether pillows, bases or other items count toward the limit is not stated.
Exchange route differs: returns page says email support@beautyrest.com; help article 1153 says call 877-298-4955.

Refund timing: returns page says refund processed within 24 hours after the carrier scans the label, then 5-10 business days at the bank; the legal 100-night text (warranties-after-march) gives no timing.
Returned mattress: returns page and help say donated through LiquiDonate; the legal 100-night text says 'Your returned MATTRESS will be recycled.'

Warranty length: help articles and product pages say '10-year limited warranty'; the warranty page, before-March and after-March pages say the period depends on the law-label code, and the charts include codes of 30 days, 1 year, 5 years and so on. No page says how the 10-year headline fits the code charts. No term_months was set at the general level.

Warranty code charts disagree: current chart on /pages/warranty uses numeric codes (9, 1, 92, 10, 6, 31); letter charts A-P are labelled 'Previous Warranty Schedule Chart as of 7/2026'. The before-March letter chart and the Beautysleep/xlsx letter chart differ on rows E, I, K, L, M, N, O (no-charge period 10/10/3/10/10/15/15 years versus equal to the total). Row C differs in wording.

/pages/warranties-after-march says the period is 'indicated on the Warranty Code Chart below' but the raw HTML has no chart table (only images and 'Please refer to www.beautyrest.com or Simmons.com for additional codes'). No chart rows could be taken from it.

The mapping from product or line to law-label code is not on any page read. Model numbers, prefixes and the date-code format are not explained on the pages read (retail SKUs such as 700812149-1020 appear only in structured data and are not decoded).
Date split is 'made after March 1, 2015' versus 'made before March 1, 2015'; a product made exactly on March 1, 2015 is in neither.

Warranty territory differs: after-March excludes claims outside 'the 50 United States, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico or U.S. Virgin Islands'; before-March excludes claims outside 'the 50 United States, Puerto Rico or U.S. Virgin Islands' (no District of Columbia).
Remedy differs: after-March and Beautysleep pages say the exclusive remedy is replacement; before-March says repair or replacement.

Parent company: no page names a parent. 'Simmons Bedding Company, LLC' is the copyright line and the party named in the after-March warranty; the Beautysleep warranty page names 'Serta Simmons Bedding, LLC'. The help center footer reads '© Tuft & Needle 2026. Powered by Help Scout'. Claim forms are hosted at forms.sertasimmons.com.

Homepage says 'all of our products come with a 100 night in-home trial, hassle-free warranties and free shipping and returns', but the baselogic Platinum and Platform product pages show no trial and only a 'Free Shipping & Returns' label, and the Platform page says nothing on returns beyond that.
Page name /pages/warranty-possibly-beautysleep suggests a draft; it appears to be the live Beautysleep.com warranty text.

Terms of Service (/pages/terms) section IX points to the 100-Night Trial Policy and Limited Warranty but those policy pages are under /policies/, which robots.txt disallows; their text was not fetched. Terms effective date is Oct 1, 2019 while help articles are dated Sept 16, 2026.
Promotions pages (Fall Sale 2026, Memorial Day Sale 2026) are price offers via participating retailers; no return or warranty terms found and no rows created.
Pages say beautyrest.com handles only its own orders; warranty on retailer purchases is the retailer's. Terms for those are not published.
